name: premium-design
title: Premium Design
description: Push the visual result toward high-end, agency-quality work: disciplined typography, generous spacing, restrained palette, purposeful imagery, with measurable anti-slop thresholds.
when_to_use: Any client-facing design where quality matters (always for ApexWeb demos).
instructions: Two type families maximum, a modular scale with clear contrast between levels, comfortable measure (45-75 characters).
Consistent spacing scale and vertical rhythm; generous white space instead of decoration.
Restrained palette: one accent used deliberately; every text/background pair passes WCAG AA.
Imagery specific to the business (or clearly art-directed placeholders) - never stock clichés or decorative blobs.
Hero: one clear message, one primary action, supporting proof; no carousel.
Cards and grids only when content is genuinely parallel; vary section rhythm to avoid template monotony.
changes: Adds hero and grid rhythm guidance and an anti-slop score threshold (80) on produced sites.
